newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian govt's opinion poll lead narrows.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian govt's opinion poll lead narrows.

text.p: The opinion poll lead held by Australia's Liberal-National government over the Labor opposition has narrowed in an opinion poll published in Tuesday's edition of The Australian newspaper.

The government's support fell one percentage point from The Australian's last poll two weeks ago to 48 percent, while Labor's support increased three points to 39 percent, The Australian's Newspoll found.
As preferred prime minister, John Howard's lead over opposition leader Kim Beazley fell to 28 points from 29 points in the last poll.
Howard's rating as preferred prime minister increased one point to 52 percent, while Beazley's rating rose two points to 24 percent.
The latest result compares with the government's primary vote of 47.3 percent and Labor's 38.8 precent in the March 2 national election that ended 13 years of Labor rule.
The Newspoll surveyed 1,147 voters around the country by telephone over the last weekend.
